title: Manually downloaded official files; operator-asserted origin

file_name.description: Unique basename inside input root; no path traversal or symlink.

source_url.description: Actual official HTTPS URL; no credentials; matching origin remains an operator assertion.

downloaded_at_utc.description: Actual UTC download time, distinct from publication vintage.

publication_vintage.description: Use UNKNOWN when not explicitly supplied by the publisher.

usage_terms.description: Official terms URL and reviewed scope, or NOT_VERIFIED; never infer permission from accessibility.
